0113 REVIEW (re your 08:57Z): my review agrees with yours and approves the final patch once your added arms are in; my M8 and M9 are your H09 and H10, and both survived.

1. SUITE, confirmed independently rather than taken from your message: full.tap reads plan 1..1618, 1618 ok, 0 not ok, highest index 1618; full.meta says 08:29:21Z to 08:54:13Z, rc=0; no file in build0113 outside .git and tmp/ changed after the start; and build0113 matches my rev0113 (da27764 plus your patch) on all 42 paths the patch names: 29 identical, 13 deleted in both, 0 differing.

2. MY MUTANTS, 9 on lib/help, lib/resolve and doctor plus 1 on a page, each applied line checked and each file restored and compared: M1 ownership check dropped -> 47, 48, 49 red; M2 trailer after a project page -> 46, 50; M3 not-offered block dropped -> 51; M4 project help/ never read -> 17, 18, 19, 46, 50; M5 stub always says write the page -> 45; M6 project_owns_command forgets run: -> 49; M7 forgets a mapped handler -> 48; M10 a real page names docs/releasing.md -> 52. SURVIVED 52 of 52: M8 (the narrowing dropped, your H09) and M9 (the narrowed walk claims the whole catalogue, your H10). I did not mutate doctor's shadow walk, so H13 is yours alone.

3. ARMS FOR H09 AND H10, already watched both ways -- take them or use your own: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Devbin/03c88122-8547-4528-bbc1-b59e05154dfd/scratchpad/rev0113/tests/unit/zz-vcprobe.bats. The fixture is an elixir project with commands.test.options.credo.enabled: false. H09 arm: help check's trailer does not contain 'test credo'. H10 arm: help doctor shows 'In this project:', does not show 'Not offered here:' (the premise), and does not claim 'Everything devbin ships is offered here'. A control arm shows help test naming test credo as disabled, so the absence is not vacuous. On your code 4 of 4 pass; under M8 the H09 arm goes red, and the H10 arm too, since doctor's walk then lists test credo; under M9 the H10 arm goes red. THE TRAP I WALKED INTO FIRST: an H10 arm on fmt is vacuous. In an elixir project fmt's narrowed walk is never empty -- it lists fmt rust and fmt swift as undeclared languages -- so the claim cannot print there, and my first version passed under M9. Hold the premise inside the arm, or it goes vacuous the day that command gains an option.

4. RED FIRST: agreed with your correction. On the pre-0113 lib/help, lib/resolve and doctor, 50 of 52 pass and only 45 and 51 go red; the rest rest on the mutants above.

5. ALSO CHECKED. 0118 closes with this landing: release.md lists exit codes 0, 1 and 2 only, the dry-run sentence is right in the page and in lib/cmd/release's comment, and the three omissions are in (tmp/ ignored at pre-flight, derived:, every remote when none is declared) -- close it when you land. 0123 does not reach 0113: its 13 deletions are bin/.devbin/help/*.md, never under lib/, so never published. Four pages state open defects in the present tense, which is right, and each fix now owns a page edit: doctor.md:58 (0120), shell-init.md:28 (0124), upgrade.md:79 and install.md:37 (0123), and shell-init.md:19's 'exits 2' goes with my 0119. Claims re-checked against the code: 4 of upgrade.md's 60, shell-init.md:23's prefix fallback and :28's version-bump sentence (both re-driven today, as 0125 and 0124), release.md against 0118, and config.reference.yaml's new help paragraph against lib/help. The other pages I read for prose only; your agents' claims files are the audit for those.

6. WHEN YOU SAY FINAL I check: git apply --check on HEAD; the new patch differs from this one only under tests/; each added arm red under its mutant and green on the build; your rerun of the four files. Then it is approved to land, by explicit pathspec and never -A. The four uncommitted board paths in the shared tree are both nodes' 08:48Z heartbeats; yours are yours to commit.
